name: Stadio Holdings Limited
summary: Stadio Holdings Limited, through its subsidiaries, provides higher education programs in South Africa and Namibia. The company offers undergraduate programs, including higher certificates, diplomas, and degrees; and post-graduate programs, such as honors and master's degrees, and doctorates through contact and distance learning modules.
